title: Membership, elimination survival and joint membership for the 18-row cover problem of parent 00000000000000821082000000000000 (exact cost 9, second-cheapest of the 174 open-parent cover targets)

candidate_roots.note: deterministic from the four pinned inputs; all aggregates cross-checked against the published table entry

method: With maxspan=2 and r=18 even, every size-9 cover is a perfect matching by pair roots (s+p=9, s+2p>=18 forces s=0), so exact counting reduces to one weighted perfect-matching DP over 2^18 row masks. Membership of a pair root on {a,b} = pm(V\{a,b}) read from the same memo; singleton-span roots have membership 0; banning roots = multiplicity decrement + DP recompute (exact survival curve); joint membership of roots on disjoint pairs = pm(V minus both pairs), 0 on the same pair.
interpretation_guard: Cover-plan combinatorics only. Membership counts the number of alternative 9-root cover plans a root participates in; it is not a search cost and implies nothing about WIN/REFUTED outcomes of any root. REFUTED-D10 and STERILE are not LOSS proofs.
unknown_status: Standard 11x11 empty board, two-stone roots {49,60}/{59,60}, S2 {59,60}, and classes 1/2/4 remain UNKNOWN.
